Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

doctor — a person who treats ill people. Example: The doctor says I should rest.
nurse — a person who cares for patients. Example: The nurse asks about my symptoms.
clinic — a small place where you see a doctor. Example: I go to the clinic on Monday.
problem — something that is wrong. Example: What is the problem?
symptom — a sign of illness. Example: What are your symptoms?
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What is the problem?
• What are your symptoms?
• I have got a pain in my ...
• Take this medicine.
• Rest for two days.
